rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone actively creates or brings something new into existence.

example.english: They originate a completely new game format.
example.traditional: 佢哋創出咗一種全新嘅遊戲形式。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 cong3 ceot1 zo2 jat1 zung2 cyun4 san1 ge3 jau4 hei3 jing4 sik1

rows.note: Use this when a plan, theory, or proposal originated with a particular person or group.

example.traditional: 呢幾個方案都係由阿明提出嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 gei2 go3 fong1 on3 dou1 hai6 jau4 aa3 ming4 tai4 ceot1 ge3

rows.note: Use this when something originated from, or was derived from, a source, place, or person rather than when stressing who proposed it.

example.english: These recipes originate from my grandmother.
example.traditional: 呢幾道菜嘅食譜嚟自我婆婆。
example.jyutping: ne1 gei2 dou3 coi3 ge3 sik6 pou2 lei4 zi6 ngo5 po4 po2
